_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score-band metrics (F&G 48, momentum ~50) already sit at the Anxiety/Complacency edge inside a documented coil where HOLD is the base-rate call until a breaker prints.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly calls Complacency/HOLD; narrative only affirms current Anxiety with no forward phase or direction
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound with fear/greed 42-55 and 30d momentum near 50
next_move.invalidated_if: fear/greed breaks under 39 with momentum rolling over, or ETF flows and momentum spike together through the top of the band
